Created by Ali Akherati, PhD and the science team at Reflective · July 2026

Every curve on this page is output from a coupled chemistry, microphysics, and photolysis model of one plume; the day/night shading follows the model's own photolysis rates. The globe is the one illustration: drift and shear follow a typical June wind so the plume has somewhere to live. Each case runs until the plume's surface area has stayed within 10% of the background for a full day.
